patch_description: Restructured into a layered pipeline: (1) RouteIndex computes single-source Dijkstra once (reused for all destinations instead of per-destination runs), (2) SharedPrefixCache avoids redundant re-transfer of shared segments, and (3) BroadcastPlanner assigns load-balanced diverse paths per partition using edge usage counts. Same inputs/outputs; lower total cost via prefix sharing and load spreading across networks.
